scope: Exact MD core sources.f compilation units, included VDP header, FX68K microcode, local wrapper and memory adapter. Not the entire upstream repository.

upstream.nested_dependencies: None for this compiled subset; all required RTL is in the pinned tree.

fx68k_license_reference.relationship: License/provenance reference, not an assertion that MDTang RTL equals that snapshot. MDTang retains modified FX68K RTL; microrom.mem and nanorom.mem compare text-identical after normalising line endings. These are CPU control tables, not a console BIOS or game ROM.

bsd_header.basis: Explicit copyright, redistribution and disclaimer text in the listed file, including synthesized-form distribution. Preserve the full original notice in source and distribution materials.

gpl_header.basis: Explicit GPL version 3 or later grant in the listed JT12/JT89 file header. Notices retained; license text in licenses/JT12-GPL-3.txt.

fx68k_directory.basis: FX68K reference repository LICENSE at the pinned commit; no individual grant in these files. MDTang root LICENSE is also GPL-3.0. Do not describe these as explicit file-header grants.

mdtang_root.basis: MDTang-authored RAM helpers under the repository-root LICENSE; no individual grant in these files. Introduced in MDTang initial commit 28461add9171ec20430454c1a6f7782349f01d4e. This is repository-scope evidence, not a claim of an explicit file-level grant.
mdtang_root.release_caveat: If explicit individual-file grants are required by release policy, obtain upstream clarification or independently replace these helpers. No invented blanket MIT/BSD grant.

fabbit_spdx.basis: Explicit SPDX identifier on the locally authored wrapper and adapter.

change_definitions.unchanged: Unmodified file from the pinned MDTang snapshot.
change_definitions.namespace_ram: Replace whole-word identifiers dpram, dpram_block and dpram32_block with retro_md_dpram, retro_md_dpram_block and retro_md_dpram32_block; retain ports and original comments/notices.
change_definitions.portable_block: Replace the Gowin DPB conditional implementation with the upstream VERILATOR portable branch. Read outputs hold on writes; dual-port synchronous reads retained. Remove the VERILATOR conditional itself; not a vendor blackbox.
change_definitions.portable_byte_cache: After portable_block, replace the 32-bit RAM array with four independent 1024x8 byte arrays in generate g_byte. Each port writes a byte only on we && be[lane], and updates read output only on !we. This retains upstream no-change output semantics and permits Xilinx byte-enabled TDP RAM inference.
change_definitions.system_boundary: Rename module system to retro_md_system and apply namespace_ram to its instances and comments. Add MEM_REQ=0, MEM_WE=0, MEM_ADDR=0 in the existing MBUS reset branch; initialise ZCLKCNT=0 with the other clock counters. Reset ram_rst_a when reset && !LOADING, otherwise increment by LOADING; connect explicit zero data_b to all four VRAM clear ports. Tie DISK=0 at multitap, and tie ramZ80 unused port wren_b/address_b/data_b to zero. Tie the already uninstantiated SVP_DO=ffff and SVP_DTACK_N=0. Remove both genesis_fm_lpf instances and all genesis_lpf instances; make fm_select_l/r=fm_adjust_l/r, DAC_LDATA/RDATA=PRE_LPF_L/R. Retain real FX68K, T80, VDP, JT12, JT89 and JT12 mixer.
change_definitions.disable_lightgun: Remove the gun_io gun instance and replace its GUN_DO connection with 8'hFF. Other gen_io/pad_io logic retained.
change_definitions.disable_debug_restore: Connect T80 DIRSet=0 and DIR=212'b0 in T80s, instead of leaving debug-restore inputs floating.
change_definitions.comment_only: Whole-word system replacements also affected four FX68K comments, changing 'emulated system' to 'emulated retro_md_system'. No FX68K logic edits.
change_definitions.change_marker: Prepend 'Modified for Fabbit on 2026-10-25; original notices retained below.' to changed files. Portable RAM files also carry a portable synchronous RAM explanation.
change_definitions.local_wrapper: New machine wrapper with fixed NTSC Americas, three-button controllers, logical memory interface, native video and stereo audio; features and startup contract in source comments.
change_definitions.local_adapter: New one-clock toggle-to-masked request/response adapter with validated address windows, big-endian/little-lane conversion, snapshot, drain-on-disable and sticky rejection fault. Not a physical SDRAM controller.

reproduction.file_paths: All path fields are relative to this MD directory, except upstream paths relative to upstream.path_base. No network fetch is needed to build the retained sources.
reproduction.source_list_paths: Entries inside sources.f are relative to the repository root, not this directory.
reproduction.extra_compile_unit: retro_md_memory.sv is deliberately not added to core-only sources.f; add explicitly for shared-memory integration.
reproduction.working_directory: Copy both initialization files into the simulator/synthesizer working directory; FX68K reads their basenames.
reproduction.upstream_comparison: Clone the upstream repository at upstream.commit. For each listed upstream file compare src/<upstream> with <path>, applying only its listed change_definitions; untouched notices and license texts must remain. This manifest describes changes; it does not claim to be an automated patch generator.
excluded: External game ROM and console BIOS assets

tests.program_provenance: Self-authored 68000/Z80 instruction sequences encoded in SV tasks, not a game ROM or console BIOS. No external binary or generator required.
tests.physical_path: Real MD core -> retro_md_memory -> retro_mem_lanes -> retro_sdram -> retro_sdram_io -> sdram_model. Only preload uses model.mem before reset release; running accesses all traverse the real RTL/DQ path.
tests.runtime_directory: gateware/build/tb_retro_md with both retained FX68K initialization files copied there

upstream_tool_exceptions.-Wno-BLKANDNBLK: Existing FX68K unpacked structs contain separate registered and combinational fields.
upstream_tool_exceptions.--no-assert-case: Existing FX68K implicit unique-case assertions fire in uninitialised startup; explicit test assertions remain enabled with --assert.
upstream_tool_exceptions.-Wno-fatal: Keep existing upstream warnings visible during the full-core build; no new testbench or adapter warnings suppressed. Standalone adapter test needs no exceptions.

tests.limitations: One synthetic program is not proof of game compatibility, DMA deadlines, CDC, physical board timing or STA.
